Api.description: Every type the app uses, gathered so one schema holds them all.
Api.title: Api

ChatCleared.description: /new: a fresh chat began, so an interface may clear what is on screen.
ChatCleared.title: ChatCleared

Failure.description: Something went wrong. Shown on its own, never mistaken for the Lead.
Failure.title: Failure

Field.description:
One question. In a form, one field of it.

kind: text (a line, or several if `multiline`), secret (hidden, never shown
or saved), choice (one of `options`), yesno, or wait (only to go on).
`pattern` is a regular expression the answer must match in full, and
`invalid` what to say when it does not (or when a required answer is
empty). A choice with `other` also takes a free answer, described by it.
Field.title: Field

Form.description:
Several fields asked together: one at a time in a terminal, on one page in a
graphical interface. `intro` lines are shown first.
Form.title: Form

JobEnded.description: A job has ended: how, what it made, what waits for approval. Written by Ombro, not the model.
JobEnded.title: JobEnded

JobProgress.description: A step in a job's journal worth showing: a role briefed, a result back, an approval asked.
JobProgress.title: JobProgress

JobStarted.description: A job started in the background, after the user's yes.
JobStarted.title: JobStarted

LeadSaid.description: The Lead's own words. `asks` is true when it is waiting for an answer.
LeadSaid.title: LeadSaid

ModeChanged.description: Chat moved into Brief, or back.
ModeChanged.title: ModeChanged

Note.description:
Something Ombro says. `items` is a list shown beneath it. `spaced` starts
a new paragraph. `level` is info, warning or done.
Note.title: Note

PastTurn.description: A turn from a chat reopened to carry on, shown again: who said it, and what.
PastTurn.title: PastTurn

Progress.description: Where something stands: interview topics covered, a test call under way.
Progress.title: Progress

ProposalShown.description: Files an interview proposes to write, waiting for the user's decision.
ProposalShown.title: ProposalShown

RoleRow.description: A role in a crew. One that can't be loaded has its name, title and problem only.
RoleRow.title: RoleRow

Usage.description: Tokens used so far against the cap, for a chat or an interview.
Usage.title: Usage
